w4-meaning~idea.cta: What a suffix means on the Word road
w4-meaning~idea.title: What a suffix means
w4-meaning~idea.body: A suffix sits at the END of a word. "-less" means without: fearless is without fear. "-ful" means full of. A suffix often changes the word's job too — "kind" describes, "kindness" is a thing.
w4-meaning~idea.more: I can say what a common suffix means.

w4-meaning~story.title: What a suffix means

li4-theme~idea.cta: What is it really about? on the Literature road
li4-theme~idea.title: What is it really about?
li4-theme~idea.body: The plot is what happens; the theme is what the story is really ABOUT, the big idea underneath. A fable often states its lesson as a moral: "Plodding wins the race". rd~keats-grasshopper.title: On the Grasshopper and Cricket
rd~keats-grasshopper.body: One small singer for summer, another for winter: the earth is never silent.
rd~keats-grasshopper.more: Taught at: Reading 4 · Poems — “On the Grasshopper and Cricket”

rd~keats-grasshopper~open.title: How it begins: On the Grasshopper and Cricket
rd~keats-grasshopper~open.body: The poetry of earth is never dead: When all the birds are faint with the hot sun, And hide in cooling trees, a voice will run From hedge to hedge about the new-mown mead; That is the Grasshopper's--he takes the lead In summer luxury,--he has never done With his delights; for when tired out with fun He rests at ease beneath some pleasant weed.
